answer: Latency Ladder Registration: each identity must continuously answer timed challenges routed through a live circuit whose cipher rotates per round. The agent proves it holds a unique physical endpoint by returning sub-50ms echoes from that endpoint; software clones sharing one host collapse onto identical timing. An operator can rent an ocean of cloud IPs but still pays one real machine's serialized round-trip budget per identity, plus a sable of scarce low-latency fiber ports, making N fakes cost N distinct endpoints.
